newsitem.title: USA: BASKETBALL-ROCKETS COACH TOMJANOVICH TO LEAD U.S. WORLD TEAM.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-ROCKETS COACH TOMJANOVICH TO LEAD U.S. WORLD TEAM.

text.p: Houston Rockets head coach Rudy Tomjanovich, who led the Rockets to NBA titles in 1995 and 1994, was named head coach of the 1998 U.S. world championship team on Saturday.
Tomjanovich will guide the U.S. squad through the world championship competition from July 29-August 9 in Athens.

By virtue of the U.S. team's gold medal performance in the 1996 Atlanta Olympics, the United States has received an automatic berth in the 16-nation tournament. Greece, as host country, also receives a berth.
The remaining 14 entrants will be determined by zone qualifying tournaments in Africa, the Americas, Asia, Europe and Oceania.

A former star player in the NBA, Tomjanovich has compiled a 281-159 regular season record for a .639 winning percentage, while leading the Rockets to two NBA titles and five consecutive playoff appearances in six years at the helm.
